attempts.failure: the first exact-blob builder invocation stopped at Python parse time because the new subprocess.check_output call was missing its closing parenthesis

attempts.failure: the 611-test exact-blob suite produced 7 failures and 34 errors because frozen runtime contracts intentionally mix object-byte and checked-out-byte hashes: Candidate manifest requires LF f912798a, while Evidence Gate holdout outputs require current CRLF working bytes 06fe9075 instead of LF blob 84f62c09
